issues: Measurement integrity: nothing wrong. The diff only changes the simulated-annealing acceptance rule. It adds a small penalty, 0.02*sum(max(0, 0.04 - r)), that discourages very small radii. It does not read files, paste coordinates or touch the evaluation.

Bugs: none that make the result meaningless. cur_v is now the penalized score and is compared only with other penalized scores (pv). best_v and best still use the true, unpenalized sum, so the packing returned is still the best valid one found and LP-feasible.

The z of -5039.9 cannot be recomputed exactly. Each arm has only 1 run, so the sample standard deviation is undefined; the harness must be using a fixed noise floor. The implied value is |delta| / |z| = 0.0072 / 5039.9 ≈ 1.43e-6, which matches the stated run-to-run noise of about 1e-6. The size of z is therefore an artifact of that floor, not a real estimate of variance.

Direction: candidate loss -2.6288 vs incumbent -2.6360. The candidate is 0.0072 worse, so the reject decision is consistent with the numbers. With n=1 per arm the evidence is thin, but a 0.0072 gap is far larger than the ~1e-6 noise between seeded runs, so reject is reasonable.
